ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): nearing a low. Bigger picture (with-trend): bullish.
points: Bigger picture is bullish (with-trend for a daily long)

entry.text: A normal mid-cycle dip below the 10-day average — the real cycle low isn't due for ~9+ trading days. Wait for support to hold, or for the next low to set up.
entry.text_zh: 这是跌破 10 日均线的正常周期中段回调——真正的周期低点要到约 9+ 个交易日后才会到来。等待支撑站稳，或等下一个低点构筑成形。

cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 早期——更大的上行段仍有充足空间
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在前半段见顶（“左移”）——弱周期见顶偏早，这暗示更大的趋势正在走弱。

ladder.early_note: ⚡ Early reversal building (anticipated): RSI bullish divergence (price made a lower low, momentum didn't). These anticipate a low BEFORE full confirmation — earlier entry, but a higher false-alarm rate, so treat as a heads-up to watch closely, not a trigger yet.
ladder.why_zh: 结构混合。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 关注 10 日均线与周期天数。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看多 — 周线动量为正；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 6 周 · 日线周期第 27 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：接近低点。大局（顺势）：看多。
points_zh: 大局为看多（对日线多头而言属顺势）
宏观：美国净流动性收缩——对概率属需谨慎

ladder.early_note_zh: ⚡ 反转正在提前酝酿（anticipated）：RSI bullish divergence (price made a lower low, momentum didn't)。这些信号会在完全确认之前预判低点——入场更早，但误报率更高，因此应视为密切关注的提示，而非触发信号。
ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 宏观逆风：美国净流动性正在收缩——在此环境下买入形态历史上胜率更低、回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是概率优势，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ NEARING A LOW signal triggered 2 trading days ago (~2026-06-16), switching from TOPPING. Signal strength: faint (score +12/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 接近低点信号于 2 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-16），自做顶中切换而来。 信号强度：微弱（评分 +12/100）。
ladder.eq_label: Entry quality: solid buy setting up (+50)
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：稳健买入构筑中（+50）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_line_zh: 日线 ✗ · 3日 ✗ · 周线 ✗ · 月线 —
ladder.bc_tip: Confidence this is a DURABLE, low-drawdown bottom: how near price is to the cycle low (the drawdown-depth axis) discounted when higher timeframes haven't confirmed the turn. Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.bc_tip_zh: 衡量当前是否为「持久、低回撤」底部的信心：价格距周期低点的远近（回撤深度轴），并在更高周期尚未确认转向时打折。实测：周线确认使「周期低点守住」的比例提升约 19 个百分点——分数越高，低点守住的概率越大。这是风险/持久性，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_knife_line: ⚠ Deep washout — price is 22% below its 200-day, a broken primary trend. Measured: setups this stretched below the 200-day held the cycle low only ~37% of the time and drew a ~−22% tail (violent bounces, rarely the durable low). Treat as knife-risk — wait for it to reclaim the 10-day average and size small. The score above is already tempered for this.
ladder.bc_knife_line_zh: ⚠ 深度超卖——价格较 200 日均线低约 22%（主趋势已破）。实测：如此远低于 200 日线的形态，仅约 37% 守住周期低点，且回撤尾部约 −22%（反弹猛烈，但很少是持久低点）。视为「接飞刀」风险——等其收复 10 日均线后再小仓参与。上方分数已据此打折。

headline.en: Rate risk runs through its market / growth beta, not a distinct duration leg.
headline.zh: 其利率风险通过市场／成长beta体现，并无独立的久期暴露。

detail.en: Own orthogonal rate (TLT) beta +0.51 ± 0.26 — medium precision. Sector anchor (XLI) reads duration-neutral (+0.01). Inflation hedge.
detail.zh: 自身正交利率（TLT）beta +0.51 ± 0.26——精度中。 板块锚（XLI）为久期中性（+0.01）。 通胀对冲。

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).
caveat.zh: 单一个股的次级beta噪声很大——应相信组合层面的汇总，而非任何单只股票的利率beta（实测样本外持续性约0.36）。
